column1: # Module (under crate::code_rule_dsl, or crate:: for the engine root) -> crate.
# The longest prefix wins. A module under transducer::packed whose declaration is cfg(target_os = "macos")
# goes to rerail-device-metal whatever this table says (crate_map.py, `gated`).
# Files stay where they are: each crate mounts its modules in place (docs/final-shape/proposals/crate-split/in-place-plan.md).
# The .rerail language's syntax and AST (front's types are cut into logic/front/ast.rs, below the parser)
# The registry, tapes and what every crate reads
# The program image's core (decision 0377); the pass manager, the passes and the analyses stay in logic
# Sessions (sql_executor.rs's #[napi] class is cut into sql_executor/napi.rs, which the engine mounts)
# Transducer (CPU, Cranelift, Bitlex, verify, the batch format), demand, space
# The engine: napi (its code_rule_dsl/mod.rs items, the slice's object, the CLI's entry points) and the tests that
# read them. Every other test is a test crate's (native/crates/tests_*, tools/cratify/split_test_crates.py).
# Boot: the composition root (incremental-plan.md, step 1b) and what only it and the engine read. Boot's mounts are
# generated from the engine's code_rule_dsl/mod.rs (tools/cratify/boot_mounts.py, boot_manifest.py).
# Java reads syntax alone (no semantic concern yet): boot keeps its adapter until a capability needs a crate
# Generic concepts every language reads (one canonical module path; embedded segments)
# Whole-file remaps found by moves.py / split.py (no item moves)
# logic/rr.rs (the module root, which reads phase0) is logic's; its children are the lowering
# Tests the index sees no read of above their crate: the children of a #[path] module (findings::async_reference's,
# above), and reads through a renamed re-export (MetalTestScope, Metal's LaunchScope).
